notes.title: Path of Motus 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I just uploaded an updated version of the game. It adds/fixes a couple of things:

- Key Remapping support for keyboard has been added in the options menu. I still recommend you play the game with a controller, but if all you have is a keyboard you can now remap the letter keys to whatever you find most comfortable. 

- There was an issue some people were having with the game crashing. Long story short, this should be fixed. 

Thanks for the support!!

Michael
